tests.title: Offset CAS race has exactly one winner

tests.oracle: Exactly one succeeds; loser sees stale revision; final revision increments once.

tests.title: Bridge claim race elects one active owner

tests.title: Stale owner heartbeat/ack is fenced

tests.action: A heartbeats and attempts delivery finalization/offset ack.
tests.oracle: All stale operations fail and current state remains owned by B.

tests.title: Different Streams progress independently
tests.setup: Concurrent writers target two Streams.
tests.oracle: Each Stream has its own ordered positions; contention does not merge sequences.

tests.title: Crash before append commit leaves no Record

tests.action: Terminate operation at barrier and reopen store.
tests.oracle: No uncommitted Record is visible. A subsequent clean append commits exactly once with a unique position greater than every previously committed position; a numeric gap is allowed.

tests.title: Lost client response after commit recovers by idempotency

tests.title: Runtime spawn uncertainty records MAY_HAVE_STARTED

tests.action: Race append commit and CAS attempt using deterministic barriers.
tests.oracle: Accepted Offset never exceeds committed head visible in the same serialization order; stale attempt retries/conflicts explicitly.

tests.title: Disk-full during append is atomic and restart-readable
tests.setup: Store with injectable VFS/write fault after transaction begins.
tests.action: Raise disk-full/IO error before durable commit.
tests.oracle: Append reports explicit failure; after reopen there is either complete prior state or complete new commit, never partial rows/idempotency/offset.
tests.failure_injection: inject SQLITE_FULL / write failure before commit

tests.title: Read-only filesystem rejects mutation without database replacement
tests.setup: Open existing valid store then make DB/directory write-protected via fixture/VFS.
tests.oracle: Explicit read-only failure; original database bytes/content remain readable after reopening read-only.

tests.title: Corrupt SQLite header/page fails explicit without auto-recreate
tests.setup: Copy fixture DB and corrupt header/page in disposable copy.
tests.action: Open Core store and run Diag.
tests.oracle: Core open/Diag reports corruption; no empty replacement DB, migration, repair or write occurs.

tests.title: Interrupted migration does not bump schema version early
tests.setup: Create N-version fixture and migration N→N+1 with injectable mid-step barrier.
tests.oracle: After reopen, schema reports N and data is valid for N; rerunning migration can complete once.

tests.title: Committed migration preserves Core records and invariants
tests.setup: Seed prior supported schema with Peer/Stream/Record/Offset fixtures.
tests.action: Run supported migration to current version.
tests.oracle: All logical data/digests/order/offset invariants remain valid and schema version advances exactly once.

tests.title: Future major schema and unsupported downgrade fail explicitly
tests.setup: Prepare metadata indicating future major version and separately a newer DB opened by older code.
tests.oracle: Runtime refuses destructive guess/downgrade and emits actionable version error without writes.

tests.title: Multi-process concurrent append preserves unique positions
tests.setup: Spawn multiple OS processes, each independent SQLite connection, same Stream.
tests.action: Release process barrier, append unique keys concurrently, then close every process/connection and reopen the database in a fresh verifier process.
tests.oracle: All successful commits are unique and strictly ordered by position; fresh verifier process reads an integrity-valid store with the same logical records; no corruption.

tests.title: Multi-process identical idempotency key collapses to one Record
tests.setup: Spawn multiple processes with same canonical append request.
tests.oracle: Exactly one logical Record exists and all success responses identify it; no duplicate positions.

tests.title: Multi-process Offset CAS has single winner
tests.setup: Multiple processes read same Offset revision.
tests.action: Race CAS to legal new positions.
tests.oracle: At most one writer with a given expected revision succeeds; losers report stale revision.

tests.title: Pre-spawn adapter failure stays NOT_STARTED and retryable
tests.setup: Fake runtime configured to fail before process/session start.
tests.oracle: Evidence is NOT_STARTED with explicit failure; Offset unchanged; retry policy may safely retry.

tests.title: Post-start timeout becomes MAY_HAVE_STARTED, not NOT_STARTED
tests.setup: Fake runtime signals started then never terminal.
tests.oracle: Evidence is MAY_HAVE_STARTED/STARTED according to durable start evidence; automatic replay remains blocked; Offset unchanged.

tests.title: Partial output then crash does not fabricate terminal Record
tests.setup: Fake runtime emits partial chunks and durable STARTED evidence.
tests.oracle: No terminal response Record is appended; partial/start evidence remains; recovery does not downgrade certainty.

tests.title: Duplicate terminal callbacks append/finalize once
tests.setup: Same delivery receives duplicate identical terminal callback concurrently.
tests.action: Process both callbacks through bridge finalizer.
tests.oracle: One response Record/finalization wins; duplicate resolves idempotently; Offset advances once.

tests.title: Restart after terminal callback before final response stays idempotent
tests.setup: Fake runtime terminal evidence/response persisted; terminate process before client/final ack.
tests.oracle: Existing terminal response is recognized; no runtime restart or duplicate response; Offset safely reconciles.

tests.title: Resume failure falls back once to fresh generation
tests.setup: Persist resumable compatible mapping; fake provider rejects resume.
tests.oracle: Bridge records resume failure, creates exactly one fresh generation and catch-up; no infinite resume loop.

tests.title: Repeated resume/fresh-session failures terminate boundedly
tests.setup: Fake provider rejects resume and fresh session creation according to bounded retry policy.
tests.oracle: Bridge exits with explicit failure/uncertainty after configured attempts; no unbounded loop or duplicate Records.

tests.title: Catch-up projection obeys injected record/byte budget in order
tests.setup: Stream with many Records and deterministic CatchUpBudget.
tests.oracle: Projection contains canonical ordered suffix fitting budget, marks truncation/boundary explicitly, and does not reorder.

tests.title: Catch-up projection never exceeds configured budget
tests.setup: Generate Streams/Record sizes and budgets including 0/1/exact boundary.
tests.oracle: Reported/serialized projection never exceeds the declared budget and always preserves included Record order.

tests.title: Context compaction/loss recovers with bounded fresh catch-up
tests.setup: Fake session loses context after several Records; durable Stream/Offset intact.
tests.oracle: Fresh session generation receives bounded catch-up projection and continues without full transcript requirement.

tests.title: Claim renew before expiry extends same generation
tests.setup: ManualClock, active claim generation G expiring at T.
tests.oracle: Renew succeeds, generation remains G, expiry extends deterministically.

tests.title: Takeover before expiry is rejected
tests.setup: ManualClock at T-epsilon; owner A claim active.
tests.oracle: B is rejected; A remains owner; generation unchanged.

tests.title: Exact expiry boundary has deterministic takeover rule
tests.setup: ManualClock exactly at expiry T.
tests.action: Owner A heartbeat and owner B takeover race under documented expiry comparison.
tests.oracle: Outcome matches TD-19 exactly; only current generation can ack/finalize afterward.

tests.title: Cancel intent commits before terminate/kill
tests.setup: Running fake runtime and Stream.
tests.action: Issue control.cancel; instrument commit and terminate call order.
tests.oracle: cancel Record commit happens-before terminate/kill invocation.

tests.title: Terminate failure leaves cancel intent durable
tests.setup: Fake runtime terminate raises.
tests.oracle: Cancel Record remains committed; failure evidence explicit; no rollback of durable history/Offset.

tests.title: Pause/cancel do not roll back Record or Offset history
tests.setup: Stream with Records and advanced Offset.
tests.oracle: Prior Records/Offset remain unchanged; controls are additional Records.

tests.title: Same-goal redirect stays in Stream and preserves history
tests.setup: Active Stream with goal metadata and history.
tests.action: Append redirect for same goal using decision helper.
tests.oracle: Redirect is another Record in same Stream; old history remains addressable.

tests.title: New goal opens new Stream referencing prior Stream
tests.setup: Existing Stream and explicit new-goal decision.
tests.oracle: Old Stream remains preserved/closed per policy; new Stream id differs and carries explicit prior reference.

tests.title: Freshness exact TTL boundary is deterministic
tests.setup: ManualClock, observation capture time C, TTL D.
tests.action: Read at C+D-epsilon and exactly C+D.
tests.oracle: Fresh/stale result matches TD-13 boundary rule exactly without mutating stored evidence.

tests.title: Out-of-order source observed_at cannot make older capture newest
tests.setup: Generate observations where source observed_at order differs from local captured_at order.
tests.oracle: Selection follows declared capture-time/order policy; source clock skew is retained as evidence but does not reorder local capture history incorrectly.

tests.title: Future-skewed source timestamp remains evidence, not synthetic freshness
tests.setup: Observation source observed_at far in future but local captured_at now.
tests.oracle: Policy uses local capture basis; no negative-age unlimited freshness is invented.

tests.title: Probe failure cannot mutate Core or trigger routing
tests.setup: Snapshot Core hashes/row counts and fake probe failure.
tests.oracle: At most explicit Observation evidence changes; Peer/Stream/Record/Offset and routing/runtime invocations remain unchanged.

tests.title: Quota exhaustion leaves Core state and peer choice unchanged
tests.setup: Active Stream/Peer; fake provider reports quota exhausted.
tests.action: Run observation/bridge cycle without routing extension.
tests.oracle: Quota observation records exhausted/unavailable; Core history/Offset unchanged except valid execution evidence; no automatic alternate Peer dispatch.

tests.title: Rate limit does not masquerade as account quota exhaustion
tests.setup: Fake runtime returns rate-limit event with separate account quota state.
tests.oracle: Rate-limit and quota remain distinct; no synthesized quota value or reroute.

tests.title: Diag reads one consistent snapshot during concurrent append
tests.setup: Reader begins transaction; writer appends/advances after barrier.
tests.oracle: Report is internally consistent to one SQLite snapshot (old or new), never mixed cross-table state.

tests.title: Unreadable optional log source is isolated
tests.setup: Core DB valid; optional log source permission/error injected.
tests.oracle: Core/Observation sections render; log section reports explicit unavailable/error; no chmod/repair/write attempted.

tests.title: Diag has zero provider/runtime calls even when data is stale
tests.setup: Stale observations and fake provider spies installed.
tests.oracle: No provider refresh, resume, route or process invocation occurs; stale state is reported honestly.

tests.title: Large Stream preserves ordering/idempotency across restart
tests.setup: Configurable test envelope with thousands of Records and mixed retries.
tests.action: Append, restart, scan, retry sampled keys.
tests.oracle: No hidden truncation/corruption; positions/order/idempotency remain valid. Runtime threshold is evidence-only, not a hard product SLA.

tests.title: Many Peers and Streams have no vendor-specific Core ceiling
tests.setup: Create configurable large N Peers across same adapter kind and M Streams.
tests.oracle: Correctness holds; any resource failure is explicit/configured, not a hardcoded provider cardinality rejection.

tests.title: Large valid Record body is never silently truncated
tests.setup: Generate valid bodies around chosen test-envelope boundaries.
tests.oracle: Exact body length/content survives or explicit configured size rejection occurs before mutation; never silent truncation.

tests.title: Wheel/sdist include required runtime schemas catalogs and skills
tests.setup: Build wheel and sdist from clean checkout.
tests.action: Inspect artifact file list and install each.
tests.oracle: All declared runtime schema/catalog/skill files are present and loadable; prohibited dev/test junk is absent per packaging allowlist.

tests.title: Installed artifact runs without undeclared dev dependency
tests.setup: Fresh venv installs runtime artifact only, excluding dev extras.
tests.action: Import package, initialize workspace, validate schemas/catalogs.
tests.oracle: All advertised runtime paths work; missing pytest/pyright/dev tools do not break runtime import.

tests.title: Declared Python support matrix is exercised or fails metadata gate
tests.setup: Read Requires-Python/classifiers and CI matrix configuration.
tests.action: Compare declared interpreter range against required CI jobs.
tests.oracle: Every declared mandatory interpreter family has a deterministic gate, or package metadata narrows support explicitly.

tests.title: Declared OS support includes Windows and path/newline smoke
tests.setup: CI metadata declares supported OSes; Windows temp paths include spaces/non-ASCII.
tests.action: Run minimal install/workspace/append/restart smoke per supported OS matrix.
tests.oracle: Every declared OS passes or is removed from declared support; Windows path/newline handling is lossless.

tests.title: Requirement dimension coverage is complete
tests.setup: Load requirements.json and test-catalog.json.
tests.action: For each requirement, union linked test dimensions and compare with required_dimensions.
tests.oracle: No required dimension is uncovered; no test references unknown requirement; declared test lists match reverse index.

tests.title: State-machine transition matrix has no uncovered required transition
tests.setup: Load STATE_MACHINE_COVERAGE.json and test catalog.
tests.action: Validate every required/forbidden transition references existing tests.
tests.oracle: Every transition is COVERED or explicitly DEFERRED with non-empty trigger; no OPEN row.

tests.title: Exception catalog has no open or unclassified case
tests.setup: Load EXCEPTION_CATALOG.json.
tests.oracle: Every case is terminal COVERED/DEFERRED/N_A/OUT_OF_SCOPE with rationale and trigger where needed; COVERED cases have existing tests.

tests.title: High-risk interaction matrix is fully covered
tests.setup: Load INTERACTION_MATRIX.json.
tests.action: Validate unique pair/interaction ids and named test references.
tests.oracle: Every REQUIRED interaction has one or more existing tests; no duplicate or OPEN interaction row.

tests.title: Provider resume rejection falls back to one fresh generation end to end
tests.setup: Persist compatible resumable mapping and unread Stream Record; fake provider rejects resume but accepts a fresh session.
tests.action: Run complete Bridge delivery cycle through fake runtime.
tests.oracle: Exactly one resume attempt is recorded, then one fresh generation is created, bounded catch-up occurs, response is appended once, and delivery completes without loop.

tests.title: Cancel intent remains durable when runtime termination fails end to end
tests.setup: Running fake runtime, durable Stream/Offset snapshot, terminate hook configured to fail.
tests.action: Issue control.cancel through public surface and restart process after termination failure.
tests.oracle: Cancel Record is present after restart, prior Records/Offset are unchanged, failure evidence is explicit, and no rollback/destructive rewrite occurred.

tests.title: Same key in different Streams is independent
tests.setup: Create Streams X/Y and same author A; choose idempotency key K.
tests.action: Append payload P with K to X and different payload Q with K to Y.
tests.oracle: Both Records append successfully and have independent positions/digests; no cross-stream conflict.

tests.title: Same key from different authors in one Stream is independent
tests.setup: Create Stream X with authors A/B and key K.
tests.oracle: Both append independently because idempotency scope includes author_peer_id.

tests.title: Same key races independently across idempotency scopes
tests.setup: Prepare same K across X/A and X/B and Y/A.
tests.oracle: Each scope resolves independently; duplicates collapse only within identical scope; no false conflicts across scopes.

tests.title: Append request cannot set server-owned Record fields
tests.setup: Build valid append request plus variants attempting record_id/position/payload_digest/appended_at injection.
tests.oracle: Server-owned fields are rejected/ignored according to request schema; caller cannot force canonical stored values; no partial mutation on invalid injection.

tests.title: Server computes payload digest and stored value matches canonical request
tests.setup: Create Stream/Peer and append request without server-owned fields.
tests.action: Append through real SQLite store, reopen, and recompute canonical digest from semantic request fields.
tests.oracle: Stored payload_digest equals server-computed canonical digest; record_id/position/appended_at are server assigned and durable.

tests.title: Read after_position boundary returns strict suffix
tests.setup: Stream positions 1..5.
tests.oracle: Results are [1..5], [4,5], [] respectively in canonical order.

tests.title: Read limit exact boundary and invalid limit are explicit
tests.setup: Stream with >3 Records.
tests.action: Read limit 1, exact remaining count, 0 and negative.
tests.oracle: Positive limits return at most limit without reorder; zero/negative are rejected explicitly and do not mutate state.

tests.title: Paged catch-up has no duplicates or skips
tests.setup: Generate Stream length N and positive page sizes.
tests.action: Repeatedly call read_records(after_position=last_seen, limit=page_size) until empty.
tests.oracle: Concatenated positions equal exactly all committed positions once and in increasing order.

tests.title: Append during paged catch-up preserves monotonic no-duplicate reads
tests.setup: Reader consumes page 1; writer barrier appends new Records before next page.
tests.action: Continue catch-up from last seen position.
tests.oracle: Reader never repeats/skips any Record <= final observed head; newly committed Records may appear only after their position and remain ordered.

tests.title: Unknown Resource Pool reference is rejected atomically
tests.setup: Valid Peer/Observation but nonexistent resource_pool_ref.
tests.oracle: Referential-integrity error; no observation row or Core mutation is committed.

tests.title: Resource Pool evidence remains isolated by pool and subject
tests.setup: Pools P1/P2; Peers A/B with observations in each.
tests.action: Query latest/list by pool and subject.
tests.oracle: Only matching evidence is returned; no pool/subject cross-leak.

tests.title: Missing captured_at falls back to observed_at for freshness
tests.setup: Observation has captured_at absent and source observed_at O; ManualClock and TTL.
tests.oracle: Freshness uses O exactly under fallback policy and obeys the same TTL boundary.

tests.title: Equal capture timestamps have deterministic latest tie-breaker
tests.setup: Generate multiple observations for same subject/kind with equal captured_at and deterministic persisted capture sequence.
tests.action: Reopen store repeatedly and call latest.
tests.oracle: The same last-captured observation wins every time independent of source observed_at or query plan order.

tests.title: Tampered package file fails checksum/manifest validation
tests.setup: Copy a validated package to temp and change one manifest-covered byte.
tests.oracle: Validation fails and names the mismatched file; it never rewrites baseline hashes to make tampering pass.

tests.title: Validator stdout and PACKAGE_VALIDATION evidence are identical
tests.setup: Run validator in clean package capturing stdout bytes/text.
tests.oracle: Normalized line-for-line validation content is identical to console output, including RESULT and every ERROR when a negative fixture is used.

tests.title: Record body accepts every JSON value class but rejects non-JSON runtime values
tests.setup: Prepare body variants: null, bool, finite number, string, array, object; plus bytes/set/custom object.
tests.oracle: All JSON value classes are accepted; non-JSON runtime values are rejected before digest/persistence.

tests.title: NaN and Infinity are rejected as non-canonical JSON numbers
tests.setup: Create payload bodies/metadata containing NaN, +Infinity, -Infinity.
tests.oracle: Every non-finite number fails explicitly before idempotency row or Record mutation.

tests.title: Canonical digest is stable across strict JSON round trip
tests.setup: Generate valid JSON payload trees with bounded depth and Unicode strings.
tests.action: Canonicalize directly, serialize strict JSON, parse, canonicalize again.
tests.oracle: Digests are identical after round trip; no serializer-specific whitespace/key order affects digest.

tests.title: Session mapping survives store/process reopen exactly
tests.setup: Persist mapping with external_session_id, generation G, fingerprint, binding, resumable/state/last_seen.
tests.action: Close store/process and reopen via fresh harness instance.
tests.oracle: All mapping fields are identical; next compatible delivery resumes generation G rather than recreating generation 1.

tests.title: Multi-process Bridge claim race elects one owner
tests.setup: Spawn independent Bridge processes/connections for same workspace+stream+peer.
tests.action: Release barrier and acquire claim simultaneously.
tests.oracle: Exactly one active generation/owner exists; losers cannot append response/finalize/ack.

tests.title: Stale owner cannot append late response after takeover
tests.setup: Owner A starts runtime; claim expires; owner B takes generation G+1.
tests.action: A receives a late terminal response and attempts response append/finalize using stale token.
tests.oracle: A is fenced before any response Record/Offset mutation; uncertainty/late evidence may be recorded only through safe non-authoritative evidence path.
tests.failure_injection: late terminal callback to stale generation

tests.title: Two Bridges recovering after crash still deliver once
tests.setup: Crash previous owner with unread Record; start two recovery Bridge processes against same store.
tests.oracle: One claim generation wins and exactly one runtime delivery/response append occurs; loser remains fenced.

tests.title: Conflicting duplicate terminal callbacks do not overwrite terminal truth
tests.setup: One delivery receives terminal response R1 then concurrent/delayed different semantic response R2 with same delivery identity.
tests.oracle: First committed terminal truth remains immutable; identical repeats are idempotent, differing repeat is explicit conflict/evidence and cannot replace response/Offset result.

tests.title: MAY_HAVE_STARTED cannot be cleared by time or restart metadata alone
tests.setup: Persist MAY_HAVE_STARTED evidence without reconcile control.
tests.oracle: Original delivery remains MAY_HAVE_STARTED and automatic retry stays blocked.

tests.title: Durable reconcile.retry authorizes a new linked attempt without rewriting old evidence
tests.setup: Delivery D has MAY_HAVE_STARTED; Stream receives control.reconcile with decision RETRY referencing D.
tests.action: Bridge consumes control and creates next attempt generation.
tests.oracle: D evidence remains immutable MAY_HAVE_STARTED; a distinct new attempt starts with its own identity/certainty and audit link to reconciliation Record.

tests.title: Reconcile retry survives restart and does not double-authorize
tests.setup: Persist MAY_HAVE_STARTED and one reconcile.retry; crash after reconciliation commit before new attempt starts.
tests.oracle: Exactly one new attempt is authorized/claimed from the reconciliation decision; old evidence remains unchanged and duplicate consumption is idempotent.
